passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
passive.text: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.text: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.text: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.text: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.text: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

archetype.value: Vex is a control mage who can turn into an assassin threat with Shadow Surge.

axis.value: Vex manipulates waves to create roaming opportunities and times trades around her fear.

winCondition.value: Vex snowballs through roams, then converts kills into objective pressure and strong teamfights.

mistakes.value: Vex loses a crucial defensive or offensive option by using her fear at the wrong time.
